receipts.title: Observational equivalence of omitted implicit helper and incorrect neighboring fill in frozen-model skill repair
receipts.strongest_reduction: generic partial identification / fault localization remains a sufficient explanation until released matched units establish same-observable, incompatible repair targets
receipts.reason: The primary paper already defines IRF and RRO as distinct root causes, uses paired execution trajectories for attribution, and reports high automatic root-cause matching. The audited primary/full-text material does not expose a downloadable released trace/label asset containing matched units with the same observable outcome/trace/differential evidence but incompatible correct repair targets. The existence claim needed by this near-miss is therefore unsupported, not falsified.
avoid: rephrasing IRF-versus-RRO confusion as a new identifiability paper without released matched units
claiming trajectory ambiguity alone when the source already performs paired trajectory attribution
launching new expensive agent rollouts only to manufacture support for the problem formulation
receipts.reopen_only_if: A released or provenance-audited dataset supplies at least one non-synthetic matched unit in which observable outcome, execution trace, and differential evidence are information-equivalent while the correct repairs are incompatible (for example add omitted helper versus correct neighboring fill), and a generic partial-identification/fault-localization baseline using the same information does not absorb the residual claim.

receipts.title: Retrieval-Mediated Technical Debt in Fixed-Weight Self-Evolving Agent Runtimes
receipts.strongest_reduction: skill technical debt with persistent skill-library defects affecting future retrieval, composition, execution, and maintenance
receipts.reason: Current primary work already treats skill technical debt as a long-lived skill-library maintenance object whose defects degrade later retrieval, composition, and execution. Splitting the realization mechanism into validity/obsolescence and retrieval exposure changes the accounting of when debt is behaviorally realized, but does not yet define an irreducible paper object beyond the same technical-debt lifecycle under identical information.
avoid: renaming skill technical debt as retrieval-mediated debt
adding retrieval exposure as a second axis without an ex-ante residual prediction
claiming stored-but-unretrieved or obsolete-and-over-retrieved artifacts as novelty by itself
receipts.reopen_only_if: New primary evidence supports an ex-ante same-information prediction about access-mediated debt that a SkillOps-style technical-debt/maintenance model with the same artifact validity, retrieval, composition, execution, and maintenance observations cannot express; a two-axis relabeling alone does not reopen the basin.

receipts.title: Endogenous Trace Observability: Separating Execution-Process Correction from Skill-Package Effects in Fixed-Weight Self-Improving Agents
receipts.strongest_reduction: treatment-induced confounding plus joint treatment-monitoring interventions / informative monitoring processes
receipts.reason: The candidate's residual claim is that a skill edit changes not only execution but the future diagnostic observation map used to evaluate that edit. Mature longitudinal causal inference already treats treatment-induced confounding and non-systematic monitoring as identification problems, and explicitly formulates joint treatment/monitoring interventions. Replacing treatment with a textual skill and monitoring with future trace exposure instantiates that mature object but does not yet add an ex-ante prediction that the same-information causal model cannot express.
avoid: renaming treatment-induced monitoring or measurement endogeneity as endogenous trace observability
claiming novelty from a textual skill changing which future logs are observed without a residual beyond joint treatment-monitoring causal inference
using matched outcome or trace-coverage summaries as evidence of a new causal object when monitoring itself is treatment-dependent
receipts.reopen_only_if: A new agent-specific primary phenomenon yields an ex-ante prediction under identical treatment, monitoring, state, task-distribution, and trace-availability information that cannot be expressed by treatment-induced confounding, joint treatment-monitoring interventions, informative monitoring/missingness, or performative/adaptive data-collection models; textual-policy terminology alone does not reopen the basin.

receipts.title: Contaminated self-tests make skill-failure causes non-identifiable in test-time skill refinement
receipts.strongest_reduction: self-generated verification inherits the defect or in-band information channel under test, so externally grounded or specification-independent verification is required
receipts.reason: Current primary work directly shows that buggy code can misguide LLM-generated tests into asserting the same erroneous behavior while suppressing bug-finding tests, and that long-running agents' in-band self-evaluation can accept stagnation or regression until an externally grounded signal is introduced. Agent-generated tests are also empirically observed to function mainly as in-band observational feedback channels. This already instantiates the candidate's structural contamination claim that a self-test generated through the suspect artifact or workflow may fail to supply independent evidence.
avoid: renaming buggy-code-induced test misguidance or in-band self-evaluation bias as a new intervention-contamination object
claiming that more self-tests solve causal ambiguity without specifying an independent information source
using skill/workflow vocabulary to restate the need for specification-based or externally grounded verification
receipts.reopen_only_if: New primary evidence demonstrates a contamination-induced non-identifiability residual that persists after matching test budget, using a specification-independent or externally grounded test generator, and controlling evaluator ancestry; the residual must not reduce to buggy-artifact test misguidance, in-band self-evaluation bias, verifier exogeneity, or generic active-testing partial identification.
